caption: Median damage over frames against severity level for rmse, one row per family of degradation and one column per field, on one shared scale. The solid grey line is damage 1, the anchor (by default the field's own mean); the dotted black line is the damage assigned to the fake prediction with the right spectrum, where the run included it. The hollow black ring marks the first level at which the metric has moved a tenth of the way to the anchor. Hollow grey markers are strengths excluded for repeating a milder one or for doing nothing. Degradations with three or fewer usable levels are drawn as markers only; points beyond 2 either side are drawn as triangles at the edge. Damage is negative where a degradation moves the metric away from the anchor, as noise raises a single-field quantity the field's mean sets to zero.
